title: queue: fetch Up Next via WEB_REMIX /next, not standard YouTube watch-next (Feature 5)
body:
## Summary

**Bug (per audit):** auto-radio / infinite-queue ne YT Music audio tracks ki jagah standard YouTube music videos (VEVO uploads, "Official Video" clips, live performances) suggest karne lag rahe the. Wajah — queue population `NewPipeRepo.relatedSongs(videoId)` → `StreamInfo.getInfo(...)` → NewPipeExtractor ka apna `youtubei/v1/next` call jo `clientName=WEB` / `ANDROID` use karta hai. Wo client standard YouTube watch-next data return karta hai (`compactVideoRenderer` / `videoRenderer` items), na ki YT Music ka audio-only "Up Next" panel.

**Fix:** radio + infinite-queue extension ke liye ek dedicated InnerTube `/next` path add kiya jo strictly `WEB_REMIX` client use karta hai aur sirf `playlistPanelVideoRenderer` items consume karta hai. NewPipe fallback rakha hai sirf for the case where WEB_REMIX panel empty aata hai (region-locked seeds etc.).

### Audit results — three points the user asked to verify

1. **`context.client.clientName` strictly `WEB_REMIX` / `ANDROID_MUSIC`, never `WEB` / `ANDROID`.**
   - `YtMusicApi.CLIENT_NAME = "WEB_REMIX"` (hard-coded const), `clientVersion = "1.20240903.01.00"`, `X-YouTube-Client-Name: 67` header. Comment in the file now explicitly warns against changing it to `WEB`/`ANDROID`. Both `/browse` and the new `/next` share the same `buildBody` / `buildNextBody` helpers, so they cannot diverge.
   - Old path (`NewPipeRepo.relatedSongs`) silently used the standard YouTube client — that's the path being replaced as the primary source.

2. **Parse queue items strictly from `playlistPanelVideoRenderer` (and `musicResponsiveListItemRenderer` for alt continuation shapes), NEVER from `compactVideoRenderer` / `videoRenderer`.**
   - New `WatchQueueParser` walks:
     ```
     contents
       .singleColumnMusicWatchNextResultsRenderer
       .tabbedRenderer.watchNextTabbedResultsRenderer
       .tabs[0].tabRenderer.content
         .musicQueueRenderer.content
           .playlistPanelRenderer.contents[]
             ├── playlistPanelVideoRenderer
             └── playlistPanelVideoWrapperRenderer.primaryRenderer.playlistPanelVideoRenderer
     ```
   - **Defense-in-depth:** parser has explicit `if (obj["compactVideoRenderer"] != null) continue` and `if (obj["videoRenderer"] != null) continue` guards. Even if a misconfigured request ever returns standard-YouTube items, they get dropped at the parser layer instead of polluting the queue.

3. **Request strictly fetches YT Music "Up Next", not standard YouTube "watch next".**
   - Endpoint hard-coded to `https://music.youtube.com/youtubei/v1/next` (note: `music.youtube.com` host, not `www.youtube.com`).
   - Body sets `isAudioOnly = true` + `enablePersistentPlaylistPanel = true` + `tunerSettingValue = AUTOMIX_SETTING_NORMAL` + `params = "wAEB"` — exactly the payload music.youtube.com itself POSTs when opening the watch page.
   - `playlistId = "RDAMVM" + videoId` — YT Music's "auto-radio" prefix. Without this YT returns just the single seed track and an empty up-next; with it we get the full radio queue.
   - `Origin: https://music.youtube.com` + `Referer: https://music.youtube.com/` + (if signed-in) the SAPISIDHASH bundle from the existing `YtAuth.sapisidHash(cookies)` helper.

### What's new on disk

```
data/ytmusic/
  YtMusicApi.kt          — +next() + +NEXT_URL + +buildNextBody() (~70 lines)
  WatchQueueParser.kt    — new file, 250+ lines, parses WEB_REMIX /next response
  YtMusicQueueRepo.kt    — new file, ~50 lines, suspend upNext(seedId): List<Song>

playback/PlayerHolder.kt — populateRadioFor + extendInfiniteQueue now share
                          new fetchRadioFor() helper:
                            YtMusicQueueRepo.upNext(seed)
                              .takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }
                              ?: NewPipeRepo.relatedSongs(seed)   // fallback
```

### Pseudo-diff of the call chain

```kotlin
// before
private fun populateRadioFor(seed: Song) {
    radioJob = scope.launch {
        val related = NewPipeRepo.relatedSongs(seed.id)   // standard YouTube /next
            .filter { it.id != seed.id }.distinctBy { it.id }
        if (related.isEmpty()) return@launch
        ...
    }
}

// after
private fun populateRadioFor(seed: Song) {
    radioJob = scope.launch {
        val related = fetchRadioFor(seed.id)              // WEB_REMIX /next, NewPipe fallback
        if (related.isEmpty()) return@launch
        ...
    }
}

private suspend fun fetchRadioFor(seedVideoId: String): List<Song> {
    val ytMusic = YtMusicQueueRepo.upNext(seedVideoId)
        .filter { it.id != seedVideoId }.distinctBy { it.id }
    if (ytMusic.isNotEmpty()) return ytMusic
    return NewPipeRepo.relatedSongs(seedVideoId)
        .filter { it.id != seedVideoId }.distinctBy { it.id }
}
```

`extendInfiniteQueue` ka body bhi same `fetchRadioFor()` use karta hai — infinite-radio mode bhi midway switch karke standard-YouTube videos pe nahi gir sakta.

### Build

`./gradlew :app:compileDebugKotlin` → `BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 38s`, no warnings introduced by this diff.

### Out of scope

- `NewPipeRepo.relatedSongs()` is kept as the fallback path. It's a strictly-better-than-empty safety net for region-gated seeds. Not removed because deleting it would push us toward an empty queue on any single `/next` failure.
- `NewPipeRepo.resolveAudioUrl()` is untouched — stream URL resolution is a separate concern from queue population.
- This PR does NOT touch `populateRadioFor`'s "only fill if queue.size == 1" gate — user-built playlist queues are still never overwritten.
